title: Basic But Just What We Needed!
text: Basic But Just What We Needed!. My daughter is moving into a small duplex next month. She would love to have one of those cute coat racks with a bench but there's just not enough room. This coat rack is pretty basic, but it's just what we needed. It will allow her and her roommate a place to hang their coats and jackets, right by the door without taking up too much floor and wall space. The pieces are sturdy and heavy. We were a little worried it might be too light weight that it might tip over if not balanced, but now that we've put it together, we're not worried any more. Assembly was easy. It looks good.

product_metadata.title: MELDEVO Wooden Tree Coat Rack Stand, 6 Hooks - Super Easy Assembly NO Tools Required - 3 Adjustable Sizes Free Standing Coat Rack, Hallway/Entryway Coat Hanger Stand for Clothes, Suits, Accessories
features: SPACE SAVING DESIGN: this coat rack takes up minimal space in foyers, living rooms, office, workspace, and keeps coats and accessories out of cramped closets and easily accessible with hooks all around the rack.

MULTIPURPOSE CLOTHING AND ACCESSORIES: 6 sturdy, convenient hooks allow you to hang several clothing items such as coats, jackets, and cardigans along with accessories like scarves, hats, handbags, briefcases, laptop bags, and umbrellas

STURDY & DURABLE DESIGN: made of Super durable heavy-duty 1.5 inch thick pinewood screw-on pieces, 2 inch thick solid wood pole and 1.2 inch diameter tri-legged base legs designed with stability and sturdiness in mind
ADJUSTABLE SIZES: assemble the coat rack according to the height you need; use 2 sections for a toddler-sized rack, 3 sections for a kid’s sized rack, or use all 4 for a standard, adult sized rack.
PRACTICAL & CONVENIENT: Easy to assemble no tools required - assemble the coat rack in just a few quick steps with the easy-to-follow instructions manual
